title: Brand Mark Lockup
description: Machine-readable layout constraints for co-brand, partner, sponsor, program, or secondary-mark lockups.

lockup_type.description: Type of mark relationship governed by this lockup rule.

ordering.description: Required visual ordering of the brand mark relative to partner or secondary marks.

contexts.description: Creative contexts where this lockup rule applies.

brand_logo_id.description: Stable `logos[].id` for the brand logo this lockup rule is anchored on.

secondary_logo_ids.description: Stable `logos[].id` values for secondary, program, sponsor, or partner marks governed by this lockup rule when those marks are represented in this brand.json.

min_gap.description: Minimum gap between marks, expressed in brand terms or units.

brand_min_optical_weight_ratio.description: Minimum optical weight of the brand mark relative to partner marks. 1 means at least equal.

partner_max_optical_weight_ratio.description: Maximum optical weight of partner marks relative to the brand mark. 1 means no larger than the brand mark. Enforcement is at layout time, not parse time — this value signals to renderers and creative agents how much space to provision for each mark.

description.description: Human-readable rationale or source-language summary for the lockup rule.
